facts.statement: The study aimed to determine if activating GLP-1 receptors in the middle part of the thalamic paraventricular nucleus changes how animals respond to alcohol.
facts.subject: computational

facts.statement: Researchers used a specific drug to block GLP-1 receptors in the mid-PVT of mice, which weakened the ability of another drug to stop alcohol from making the mice move more.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: A separate group of rats that drank alcohol but had not received prior treatment showed no difference in the amount of GLP-1 receptor gene material in the PVT between males and females.
facts.subject: animals
